observations.body: Assyria resettles Samaria; a priest teaches the LORD’s worship, yet the peoples continue making gods and sacrificing at the high places.
observations.label: Imported peoples combine fear and rival worship

observations.body: The passage presents imperial resettlement, lions, priestly teaching, high places, local gods, children, and divided fear as the scene's observable response or movement.

payload.posture: Read 2 Kings 17:24–41 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
